notes: Parent-only pass across 28 broad platform/type lanes. URL/title/alias and prior-decision screening precedes pinned primary-source inspection. Thirty-two additions, four substantive-evidence deferrals, three predecessor/successor decisions. Current successor repositories were separately screened and inspected rather than trusting stale descriptions. Format support is based on implemented modules when README lags. Repository source, generated locally from required originals, partial boot listings and placeholders are kept distinct. Large tree failure handled by bounded source-directory listing. No candidate code executed. AI configuration files alone never count as AI disclosure. Original-byte demo source is distinguished from fixed or relocated rebuilds.
